q: Which steel carbon figure should a Jamshedpur ancillary unit use for steel bought from the integrated mill?
title: Ancillary units: the mill's steel figure
short: Use the mill's own product figure for the grade and year you bought, from its product footprint, EPD or CBAM data, and keep the document. Only fall back to a published average if the mill will not share one, and label it. Steel is usually most of an ancillary part's footprint.
audience: Fabrication, forging, pressing and machining ancillaries in Adityapur, Gamharia and Jamshedpur buying steel from integrated mills

sections.h: What to ask the mill or stockist
ul: kg CO2e per tonne for the product: coil, plate, bar or section.
Whether any low carbon claim rests on certificates and how they are tracked.

p: If you buy from a service centre, ask for mill test certificates and the mill's figure. Add cutting and transport separately.
Your electricity, fuel and process scrap, split by parts made. Process scrap sent back to the mill is reported as waste, not subtracted.

senseible: Senseible reads steel, electricity and fuel invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so the steel tonnes and supplier figure behind a part trace back to the documents.
